RailwayInstallationSchema.Name: Example installation drawing
RailwayInstallationSchema.Description: One sheet per selected object: cross section, dimensions, track box and cartouche.
RailwayInstallationSchema.RailwayInstallationDrawingScript:
-- Layout: one A4 portrait sheet per object (no growth - see RailCOMPLETE's built-in script for A4 -> A3), drawing -- units = metres, section at 1:50 on paper. -- Contract: report the section transform, the dimension style and the sheet frame through LayoutReport; -- RailCOMPLETE then draws the dimension arrows and creates the paper-space layouts itself.
local _SCALE_ = 1 -- 1 = A4 frame of 10.5 x 14.85 units; 2 = everything twice as large in model space (the layout still plots the section at 1:50) local _REQUIRE_TRACK_ = true -- false for drawings of objects away from any track (front elevations)
-- Warnings: write() is not shown to the user during the export, so also try the command line. local function warn(message) local shown = pcall(function() DocumentData.Document.Editor:WriteMessage("\n" .. message) end) if not shown then write("\n" .. message) end end
local function getAcadPoint3D(p) return cadInterface.createCadEntity("Geometry.Point3d", {p.X, p.Y, p.Z}) end
local function createAcadPolyline(points, closed) local polyline = cadInterface.createCadEntity("DatabaseServices.Polyline", {}) local index = 0 for _, v in pairs(points) do polyline:AddVertexAt(index, cadInterface.createCadEntity("Geometry.Point2d", {v.X, v.Y}), 0, 0, 0) index = index + 1 end polyline.Closed = closed or false polyline.Layer = "0" return polyline end
local function createText(contents, location, attachment, scaleFactor) local text = cadInterface.createCadEntity("DatabaseServices.MText", {}) text.Contents = contents text.TextHeight = 0.125 * scaleFactor text.TextStyleId = cadInterface.getTextStyleId("RC-STANDARD") text.Attachment = cadInterface.createCadEntity("DatabaseServices.AttachmentPoint", {attachment}) text.Location = getAcadPoint3D(location) return text end
-- Frame-local point (as delivered by RailCOMPLETE) -> sheet point, given the section block's position and scale. local function toSheet(point, sectionPosition, scaleFactor) return getPoint3D(sectionPosition.X + point.X * scaleFactor, sectionPosition.Y + point.Y * scaleFactor) end
-- Track box under each track centre line: name, radius, cant. local function getTrackInfoEntities(alignmentSnapshot, centerLinePoint, scaleFactor) local radius = alignmentSnapshot.Radius local hasRadius = radius ~= nil and radius == radius and math.abs(radius) ~= math.huge local cant = alignmentSnapshot.Cant local hasCant = cant ~= nil and cant == cant local contents = "Track : " .. tostring(alignmentSnapshot.Name or "?") .. "\\PRadius : " .. (hasRadius and string.format("%.0f m", math.abs(radius)) or "-") .. "\\PCant : " .. (hasCant and string.format("%.0f mm", math.abs(cant)) or "-") local text = createText(contents, getPoint3D(centerLinePoint.X, centerLinePoint.Y - 0.6 * scaleFactor), "TopCenter", scaleFactor) text.ShowBorders = true return {text} end
local function createSheet(data, sheetTopLeft, scaleFactor) local pointObject = data.PointObject local hasTrack = data.AlignmentSnapshots ~= nil and data.AlignmentSnapshots.Count > 0 -- test .Count, never index blindly if _REQUIRE_TRACK_ and not hasTrack then -- The preview still lists the object (Warning status, "Content preview" badge) and keeps it ticked for export. if not _railwayInstallationDrawingPreviewMode then warn("Installation drawing skipped for " .. tostring(pointObject.name) .. ": no track inside its cross section frame.") end return nil end
local width = 10.5 * scaleFactor local height = 14.85 * scaleFactor local margin = 0.5 * scaleFactor local cartoucheHeight = 2.5 * scaleFactor local sectionBandHeight = height - 2 * margin - cartoucheHeight
-- 1. The section: everything RailCOMPLETE projected and generated, as one block with a frame-local origin. local blockName = "section_" .. generateGuid() local makeBlock = cadInterface.insertBlock or cadInterface.createBlock -- createBlock is the deprecated name makeBlock(blockName, table.select(data.AllEntities)) local bandCentre = getPoint3D(sheetTopLeft.X + width / 2, sheetTopLeft.Y - margin - sectionBandHeight / 2) local section = cadInterface.createBlockReference(blockName, bandCentre) -- takes an RC Point3D -- Frame-local coordinates have no meaningful absolute origin: centre the block on its own bounds -- (measured at scale 1, then scaled - the same order as RailCOMPLETE's built-in script). local bounds = section.Bounds local contentCentre = getPoint3D((bounds.MaxPoint.X + bounds.MinPoint.X) / 2, (bounds.MaxPoint.Y + bounds.MinPoint.Y) / 2) section.Position = getAcadPoint3D(getPoint3D(section.Position.X + (bandCentre.X - contentCentre.X) * scaleFactor, section.Position.Y + (bandCentre.Y - contentCentre.Y) * scaleFactor)) section.ScaleFactors = cadInterface.createCadEntity("Geometry.Scale3d", {scaleFactor})
-- 2. Dimensions: RailCOMPLETE draws them when PlaceDimensionsExternally is true (export and preview). -- DimensionExtents tells how much room they take; use it to grow the sheet if you implement growth. if not data.PlaceDimensionsExternally then warn("Stand-alone run or pre-contract RailCOMPLETE: dimensions are not drawn.") end
-- 3. Report the section transform, dimension style and sheet frame. Guards keep older RC builds working. local sheetName = pointObject.name or "" -- empty: RailCOMPLETE names the layout after the object's identity (+ " (up)"/" (down)") if sheetName ~= "" and (data.FrameDirection == "up" or data.FrameDirection == "down") then sheetName = sheetName .. " (" .. data.FrameDirection .. ")" end local report = data.LayoutReport if report then report.SectionOriginX = section.Position.X report.SectionOriginY = section.Position.Y report.ScaleFactor = scaleFactor report.Reported = true if data.PlaceDimensionsExternally ~= nil then report.ScriptDrewDimensions = not data.PlaceDimensionsExternally report.DimensionStyleReported = true report.DimensionTextHeight = 0.125 report.DimensionArrowSize = 0.075 report.DimensionExtensionLineExtension = 0.05 report.DimensionExtensionLineOffset = 0 report.DimensionTextGap = 0.025 report.DimensionMeasurementScaleFactor = 1000 report.DimensionDecimalPlaces = 0 report.DimensionTextStyleName = "RC-STANDARD" end if report.SheetReported ~= nil then report.ScriptCreatedLayouts = false report.SheetReported = true report.SheetName = sheetName report.SheetWidth = width report.SheetHeight = height report.SheetTopLeftX = sheetTopLeft.X report.SheetTopLeftY = sheetTopLeft.Y end end
-- 4. Annotations anchored on points of interest (never on absolute frame-local coordinates). local entities = {section} local pointsOfInterest = table.select(data.PointObjectPointsOfInterest) if hasTrack then for _, snapshot in pairs(table.select(data.AlignmentSnapshots)) do local anchor = table.firstOrNil(pointsOfInterest, function(p) return p.Item2 == "CenterLine" and p.Item3 == snapshot.Id end) or table.firstOrNil(pointsOfInterest, function(p) return p.Item2 == "CenterLine" and p.Item3 == "OwnAlignment" end) if anchor then for _, e in pairs(getTrackInfoEntities(snapshot, toSheet(anchor.Item1, section.Position, scaleFactor), scaleFactor)) do table.insert(entities, e) end end end end
-- 5. Sheet frame and cartouche. local left, right = sheetTopLeft.X, sheetTopLeft.X + width local top, bottom = sheetTopLeft.Y, sheetTopLeft.Y - height table.insert(entities, createAcadPolyline({getPoint3D(left, top), getPoint3D(right, top), getPoint3D(right, bottom), getPoint3D(left, bottom)}, true)) local innerLeft, innerRight = left + margin, right - margin local innerTop, innerBottom = top - margin, bottom + margin table.insert(entities, createAcadPolyline({getPoint3D(innerLeft, innerTop), getPoint3D(innerRight, innerTop), getPoint3D(innerRight, innerBottom), getPoint3D(innerLeft, innerBottom)}, true)) local cartoucheTop = innerBottom + cartoucheHeight table.insert(entities, createAcadPolyline({getPoint3D(innerLeft, cartoucheTop), getPoint3D(innerRight, cartoucheTop)}, false)) local cartoucheText = "{\\LObject: " .. tostring(pointObject.name) .. "}" .. "\\PType: " .. tostring(pointObject.RcType) .. "\\PScale 1:50" table.insert(entities, createText(cartoucheText, getPoint3D(innerLeft + 0.1 * scaleFactor, cartoucheTop - 0.1 * scaleFactor), "TopLeft", scaleFactor))
-- 6. Draw in sheet space, then transform everything by the current UCS as the very last step. local ucs = DocumentData.Document.Editor.CurrentUserCoordinateSystem for _, entity in pairs(entities) do cadInterface.runEntityMethods(entity, {TransformBy = {ucs}}) end cadInterface.addEntitiesToModelSpace(entities) return {width = width} end
-- Main. Export and preview inject _railwayInstallationDrawingSelectionData; RC-RUNSCRIPT does not. local selection if _railwayInstallationDrawingSelectionData then selection = table.select(_railwayInstallationDrawingSelectionData) else local data = getRailwayInstallationDrawingSelectionData("Example installation drawing") if not data or data.Count == 0 then return end selection = table.select(data) end
-- askForPoint is preview-safe (returns the origin in preview); most other ask* prompts are NOT. local point = askForPoint("Insertion point:") if not point then return end point = table.firstOrNil(cadInterface.runEntityMethods(getAcadPoint3D(point), {TransformBy = {DocumentData.Document.Editor.CurrentUserCoordinateSystem:Inverse()}}))
local offset = 0 for _, data in pairs(selection) do local result = createSheet(data, getPoint3D(point.X + offset, point.Y), _SCALE_) if result then offset = offset + result.width + 1 * _SCALE_ end end

Section2DItemWrapper.Formula: local points = {getPoint3D(1.3, -0.172), getPoint3D(1.3, -0.395), getPoint3D(-1.3, -0.395), getPoint3D(-1.3, -0.172)} return table.select(points, function(p) return RC_ApplyLiftAndRotate(this, _alignmentSnapshot.PointObjectDistanceAlong, p, _alignmentSnapshot.Cant) end)

Section2DItemWrapper.Formula: return table.select({getPoint3D(0, 0), getPoint3D(0, 6.0)}, function(p) return RC_ApplyLiftAndRotate(this, _alignmentSnapshot.PointObjectDistanceAlong, p, _alignmentSnapshot.Cant) end)

Dimension.Name: EX_LateralOffset
Dimension.SetValueScript:
if this.Alignment == nil then return end local alignmentSnapshot = _alignmentSnapshots[this.Alignment.id] if alignmentSnapshot == nil then return end
-- Compute everything first: each this.X assignment below is saved immediately. local cantInMeters = (alignmentSnapshot.Cant or 0) / 1000 local cantGauge = this.Alignment.AlignmentSystem.CantGauge local innerRailDistance = math.cos(math.asin(cantInMeters / cantGauge)) * alignmentSnapshot.AlignmentGauge / 2
-- _dimensionValue is in metres (the typed millimetres divided by the style's Dimlfac). Its magnitude is the distance -- from the nearest inner rail; a negative value moves the object across that rail. local distanceFromTrackCentre = _dimensionValue < 0 and (_dimensionValue - innerRailDistance) or (_dimensionValue + innerRailDistance) local newLateralOffset = RightSided and distanceFromTrackCentre or -distanceFromTrackCentre
-- Clear the formula of the property that would recompute LateralOffset, then assign (which clears LateralOffset's own): this.DistanceToAlignment = "=" this.LateralOffset = newLateralOffset
